# Preview assets

- `barlow-condensed-bold.ttf`: Barlow Condensed, downloaded from the Google Fonts repository (`ofl/barlowcondensed`). See `barlow-OFL.txt` for its original copyright and SIL Open Font License.
- `silkscreen-regular.ttf`: Silkscreen, downloaded from Google Fonts (`ofl/silkscreen`). See `silkscreen-OFL.txt`.
- `corporate-memphis.png`, `solarpunk.png`, `frutiger-aero.png`: original generated artwork. Exact prompts and generation method are in `docs/artwork-prompts.json` at the repository root.
- `previews/*.webp`: locally rendered captures of this repository’s own shared showcase. Regenerate using `node scripts/browser-audit.mjs thumbnails` with the local app and Chrome running.

The illustration slot is decorative; essential content and controls are HTML. No source-research images are redistributed.

## Original vector construction

The `doodle-*.svg`, `isometric-*.svg`, `gothic-*.svg`, and `mosaic-*.svg` assets are original geometric/line artwork authored for the twelve new previews. They use no external imagery or fonts and are covered by the repository MIT license. The artwork is decorative; the live HTML supplies all meaningful content.
